title: There's more to do before you ask 'Are you sure?'
partialText: Before adding 'Are you sure?', work out what the person still needs to choose, check or try.

title: The system broke it. Why is the user fixing it?
partialText: Products are good at detecting failure. They're often much worse at making clear who can actually fix it.

title: When a redesign makes familiar work slower
partialText: A cleaner redesign can still be a worse tool for the people who know it best.

title: Stop turning every answer into text
partialText: AI can answer the question and still make the user do the work of turning it into something useful.

title: Remember the work, not just the user
partialText: Remembering a login is easy. Remembering what someone was trying to finish is where the product promise starts.

title: Your product is making people wait in the dark
partialText: A waiting state should tell someone what is happening, what they can safely do next, and what happens if nothing changes.

title: Your churn survey might be lying to you
partialText: A churn reason is not clean evidence if the cancellation flow shaped the answer before the user gave it.
